professionalService.problemSolved: Let an architect, material supplier or client inspect how a proposed facade bond and physically projecting headers read at drawing scale, under normal/raking sun and at human approach scale.
professionalService.serviceOutcome: A 1:20 ink facade becomes a material wall; the same header lattice casts changing real shadows, is inspected close up and remains continuous through the porch into the hall.
professionalService.decisionValue: Can support material/relief discussion and sample-panel evaluation. Kiln & Course, KC-06, 60 mm headers, mortar and order CTA are invented donor specifications, not verified Rubik material/project facts.
